# Script to clear root's bash history and remove specific entries from auth.log

    > "$HISTORY_FILE"
    log_message "Cleared bash history at $HISTORY_FILE"
else
    log_message "No bash history file found at $HISTORY_FILE"
fi

# Remove specific entries from auth.log
if [ -f "$AUTH_LOG" ]; then
    # Create a backup of the original file
    cp "$AUTH_LOG" "$AUTH_LOG.bak"
    
    # Filter out lines containing specific patterns (example: root login entries)
    # This is a sample pattern - can be modified as needed
    grep -v "root" "$AUTH_LOG" > "$TEMP_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
    
    # Copy the filtered content back
    cp "$TEMP_LOG" "$AUTH_LOG"
    
    # Clean up temporary file
    rm -f "$TEMP_LOG"
    
    log_message "Filtered auth.log - removed entries containing sensitive patterns"
else
    log_message "No auth.log file found at $AUTH_LOG"
fi
